''Source of truth: the [https://github.com/occupysaas/salescompel#readme SalesCompel README on GitHub]. This page is a summary as of 23 November 2026; check the README for the current state.''

SalesCompel is an open-source, free-to-use Salesforce replacement project, with a tenant-isolated Go and PostgreSQL candidate and a Vue record workflow.

{| class="wikitable"
|-
| '''Replaces'''
| Salesforce (not affiliated; name used only to describe compatibility)
|-
| '''Status'''
| Early. Not production-ready, not certified, and makes no 1:1 compatibility claim
|-
| '''Licence'''
| Apache-2.0
|-

| Go, Vue, TypeScript
|-
| '''Storage'''
| PostgreSQL, multi-tenant
|-
| '''Repo'''
| [https://github.com/occupysaas/salescompel github.com/occupysaas/salescompel]
|}

<span id="what-works-today"></span>
== What works today ==

* Persistent Account and Contact create, read, update and delete
* Object describe and limited queries, plus a SOQL query engine with parent paths, subqueries, aggregates and paging
* External-ID upsert and bearer authentication
* OAuth login and identity (authorization code with PKCE, refresh, JWT bearer, client credentials)
* Composite and sObject Collections
* An OpenAPI REST contract and an offline compatibility laboratory
* An exploratory Vue UI prototype using synthetic data, with light and dark themes and localization including right-to-left

<span id="what-is-not-in-the-first-release"></span>
== What is not in the first release ==

Apex, Flow and custom UI (LWC, Aura, Visualforce) are excluded from the first release and come later. Orgs that rely on them cannot move yet.

<span id="roadmap"></span>
== Roadmap ==

The next goal is a <code>0.x</code> early preview for new teams and simple Salesforce orgs: a working sales CRM with a Salesforce-compatible API that standard clients can use, and an import with a dry-run report naming what will not carry over.
